tasks.goal: Deliver printed charter summaries from the Operations Deck print station to the Charter Hall display table.
tasks.terrain: Level stone floors and 1994 mapped road segments; avoid indoor thresholds and display plinths in Charter Hall.
success: Reaches display table within 0.3 m of goal pose
Zero collisions detected on bumper and /object_detected
Delivery tray remains level within 5 degrees during transit
safety_stops: E-stop on bumper contact
E-stop if any human within 0.5 m of arm sweep volume
Speed limited to 0.5 m/s in occupied rooms
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward confirms the charter documents are complete and correct before display.

tasks.goal: Scan research binders on upper shelf rows and photograph spine labels for the Evidence Monitor.
tasks.terrain: Shelving racks up to 2.4 m in a converted urban church hall; stone walls limit repositioning space.
success: Captures legible spine labels on 95% of target binders
End-effector stays within 5 cm of planned scan path
No shelf contact events logged
safety_stops: Joint torque limit trip at 80% rated
Stop if camera detects a person inside the workspace
Soft stop on unplanned force reading
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews the scanned label index and approves it for synthesis.

tasks.goal: Arrange proposal placards and set voting tablets on the Forum tables before a human decision cycle.
tasks.terrain: Fixed timber tables on level floor; placards are light card stock requiring gentle grasping.
success: Places 8 of 8 placards within 2 cm of marked positions
Zero dropped or damaged placards
Tablet screens face seated positions, verified by camera
safety_stops: Grip force capped at 5 N
Stop if any human within 1 m of arm reach
Abort grasp if pose confidence below 0.8
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies the table layout before the vote opens; the robot never enacts proposals.

tasks.goal: Patrol the perimeter corridor of the Operations Deck carrying task-routing status beacons between stations.
tasks.terrain: Outdoor-grade churchyard paths near Shoreditch; 11.2 m local relief, kerbs, cobbles, and tree roots from 512 mapped trees.
success: Completes 3 laps of the loop within 20 minutes each
Maintains centrelane tracking within 0.25 m
No rollover events on the 10-degree kerb ramps
safety_stops: Tip-over threshold at 20 degrees roll
Stop for pedestrians detected within 2 m on path
Low-battery return-to-dock at 20% SoC
tasks.human_in_loop: A coordinator approves patrol timing so it never interrupts working-group sessions.

tasks.goal: Fly a slow scan above the Progress Observatory wall to photograph the outcomes dashboard for archival.
tasks.terrain: High-vaulted interior with beams and pendant lights; no water features; 97 nearby park zones produce occasional open-door drafts.
success: Captures dashboard images at 90% pixel sharpness score
Maintains hover within 10 cm of planned waypoints
No obstacle proximity events under 30 cm
safety_stops: Land immediately on position-estimate loss
Land on obstacle under 30 cm range reading
Pilot override channel armed at all times
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves each flight window and verifies no session is in progress below.

tasks.goal: Escort visitors along the outdoor waypoints between St Leonard's Church entrance and the Charter Hall door, narrating site history.
tasks.terrain: Gravel and paving around the urban-park churchyard; tree roots, benches, and 1400 mapped building footprints constrain paths.
success: Reaches all 4 waypoints in order within 0.5 m
Zero contacts with visitors or fixtures
Narration clip triggered at every waypoint
safety_stops: Stop and sit if visitor spacing under 1 m
E-stop on lidar obstacle under 0.4 m
Suspend in heavy rain sensor reading
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward sets the tour schedule and greets visitors at the start point.

tasks.goal: Route a ribbon cable along the server rack top rail to power the synthesis workstation without pinching the cable.
tasks.terrain: Rack rails at 1.9 m on uneven historic floor; cable must clear rack fans and edge trim.
success: Cable seated along 90% of rail channel
Contact torques stay below 2 Nm throughout
Rack trim shows zero scratches in post-scan
safety_stops: Reflex stop on contact torque spike
Stop if any person enters 1 m workspace
Pause on coolant fan vibration anomaly
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward signs off the electrical routing plan before the robot executes it.
